title: Disappearing Ink
description: Draw with a finger or mouse — the ink fades away a few seconds after it's laid down.

title: Card Battler
description: A small turn-based card game and an animation-architecture demo in one — drag cards to the board and watch scripted strikes play out in full flight paths, shake and sparks included.

title: Cards
description: The same card battler, restocked live from a trading-card design tool: every deck is drawn from a published card pool and weighted by rarity.

title: Buster Whack
description: A virus-busting arcade game on an unbounded road: wipe each arena's guard, take the ground, walk to the next fight. Charge shots, dodge the bolts they fire back, and bomb what stands in a 3x3.

title: Buster Whack 3D
description: A movement, aiming and camera prototype for Buster Whack: the buster rebuilt as a low-poly 3D humanoid on the same board, hopping square to square, aiming in four, eight or any direction, strafing under a lock, and firing at rotters that fire back — under five cameras. A story / advance mode reproduces the 2D original's endless road on top of it: a countdown clock, arenas that wake and clear onto the next, and towers with a keeper to talk to.

title: Moon Rangers
description: A hoverbike ride across the lunar surface, built on the engine pulled out of Buster Whack 3D: no board and no squares, forward is not a choice, and the only obstacle is the boulder — go around it or take it apart with the buster.

title: ZPKT HW002
description: A 33-second demo in the old demoscene style. HW002 plays from one Ableton Live set, with no generated audio, and every picture is built from a screen recording of that set: textmode, a tunnel, a rotozoomer, a box of agents' screens and a kaleidoscope.

title: Snake Recursion
description: A snake that plays on its own surface: every segment of its body is a screen showing the game it is playing, snake included, all the way down. It plays itself until you take the keys.

title: Snake Skin
description: Snake Recursion, done properly: the field is the snake's own skin, cut open and laid flat, so the whole board corresponds to the whole body and the snake plays on itself at every level.

title: Core Library
description: Sign in with Bluesky to drill a core out of your account. Each bed of rock is one week, from this week down to your first. Every core gets an accession number and a permanent page.

title: Four by Four
description: Solo chess puzzles on a 4x4 board, in 3D. Every move is a capture, each piece may capture twice, and you win by leaving one piece standing. Thirty puzzles, each proved solvable by brute force.

title: Juice Box
description: A shelf of things to open: a big button, a chest, a gift, a crate, an egg and a jar of fireflies. Screen shake, hit stop, particles, squash and stretch, layered foley sound and the rest of game juice are laid over them, each with its own switch, so you can turn it off and see what is left.

title: 4x4x4
description: The sequel to Four by Four: solo chess in a tower of 4x4 glass floors. Every move is a capture and you win by leaving one piece standing. Forty puzzles in four acts bring in a unicorn that moves through corners, floors you must leave to take, gravity, a light to finish on, and pieces that become what they take. Paced by simulated players calibrated on how far people got in the first game.
